comments: Does it work if you configure without the `no-module` entry?  I don't remember if that disables loadable providers or not?

I tried configuring without 'no-module' switch but it didn't help, unfortunately. Same errors occured as before: in 80-test_pkcs12.t (Failed tests: 16-19, 21) and 90-test_asn1_time.t (iteration 5 with 'INVALID' conversion).

I also have this problem with the current commit e5f831a but only with 80-test_pkcs12 (same tests: 16-19 and 21).

I am on windows 10 using MSYS2 with mingw64:
- gcc: 11.3.0
- perl: 5.32.1

I can confirm: all pkcs12 tests (80-test_pkcs12.t) are now passing. :-)

Still waiting for second fix against 90-test_asn1_time.t (with INVALID conversion).
